note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. A and B differ only in whether the chosen object has a row on the inventory list; no winner, score or consequence is drawn and nothing is said about what a missing entry means. Times are illustrative and imply no time limit. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, scenarioA, scenarioB, changedFact, sharedFacts, comparisonLabels (+ changedItem). Coordinator decision 2026-10-06 (evidence-custody-05 iteration 2): the long-labels-stress entry references are shortened to "Entry 26-0x" (still longer than the baseline references) so the cell tags can carry them. Coordinator decision 2026-10-06 (evidence-custody-05 iteration 3, standing stress-cap rule): the long-labels-stress preset is capped at 3 objects / 3 list rows (equal to the baseline count); every text stays longer than its baseline counterpart.
